weekly_intro.en: The main phase of the season has officially begun — welcome to Week 1 of the Weekly Rankings. Back in the Preliminary Round, I evaluated 38 titles. Of those, 8 titles sadly (...or, actually, absolutely not!) didn't make the cut, leaving 30 shows to advance to the main round. Add another 4 titles that I'd already given seeded spots becasue they start airing later, and our initial Season Pool to 34 titles. Some of the impressions and scores here overlap with the Prelim, but this time I'm focusing strictly on episodes aired within the past week, so the overall picture is a little different. From here on, I'll be evaluating each show's latest episode week by week, comparing it with the other shows airing during that same week. There are also quite a few shows I only talked about in the Prelim, as well as some where I evaluated different episodes. So if you haven't checked out the Prelim rankings yet, be sure to give them a look! And now, let's get into this week's rankings!
weekly_intro.ja: いよいよ本選がスタート！ 前哨戦であるプレリムラウンドで評価した３８作品から８作品が惜しくも(？)予選落ちし、残る３０作品が本戦に進出しました。　さらに、放送開始が遅いため、あらかじめシード枠にしていたしていた４作品を加え、本戦開始時のSeason Poolは３４作品となりました。また、今回のランキングでは、プレリムと感想や評価が重なる部分もありますが、対象を直近の１週間の放送分に限定しているため、全体の所感は若干異なります。 というわけで、ここからは毎週、それぞれの作品の最新エピソードを評価し、同じ週に放送された作品同士で比較していく形になります。プレリミナリ・ランキングでしか触れていない作品や、また今回とは対象のエピソードが違う作品も結構ありますので、未見の方は、是非併せてチェックしてみてくださいね。 それでは、今週のランキングをどうぞ！

第13話:

もともと好きな作品だったし、楽しみにしてただけに残念。この話を見たところでこれまでが全くわからないので何をどう思えばわからない状況。とにかくただ戦闘が行われたりして話が進む。結構入り組んだ事情などあったり、そこそこキャラも多いので、誰が誰でどこで何をしていて何が過去にあったのか・・・一つもわからないというのはあまりに置いてけぼり過ぎて酷い。なんとか2話やこれからちゃんと回復して見せて欲しいものだ。せっかく1期が良かったのだから。また、そんな中あの寡黙な激強剣士がMCにちょっとグイグイ迫って来てるのも、1期にはなかったのでイキナリ過ぎて萎える。作画やクオリティの向上など二の次でいいから、以前のいい流れをせめて保って欲しい。

comments.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
comments.en: I had a bad feeling when I saw the key visual, and unfortunately, I was right. The characters have lost much of their charm, and the overall quality has noticeably declined. After several years away, Season 2 returns without any recap, while cranking up the ridiculous antics and having every female character—including the MC's mentor—fall head over heels for him. What a mess. Newcomers wouldn't have a clue what the story is about, who the MC is, or what he's trying to achieve. An absolutely disastrous premiere, and a painful disappointment for those of us who loved Season 1.

comments.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2
comments.en:
I've always liked this series and was looking forward to its return, so this was disappointing. The episode throws us straight into battles and ongoing events without enough context to remember who's who, where they are, what they're doing, or what happened before. With such a large cast and complicated relationships, being left this completely in the dark is frustrating. I really hope the next few episodes can get things back on track, because the first season was genuinely good.

And what's with Ajest, the quiet powerful swordswoman suddenly coming on so strong to the Desir? There was nothing like that in Season 1, so it feels forced and off-putting. Forget improving the animation or production quality for now. I'd much rather they preserve what made the first season so enjoyable.

review.en:
Episode #1

Well, well, what a surprise! This might actually be the most entertaining show of the bunch... And with a cast of relatively newer voice actors, everything feels incredibly fresh. Rather than another one of those cheap, dime-a-dozen revenge fantasies or villainess stories, we get this intriguing setup involving a mysterious, overwhelmingly powerful being with barely any memories of its own, reincarnated into the body of a girl who's dying from an illness—all for the sake of a single day. I love how the story unfolds from there, and how the protagonist seems just eager enough to show off that ridiculous power without going overboard. The pacing, the presentation, the way each moment lands—everything just clicks. Seriously, my expectations are through the roof! And to top it all off, both the OP and ED absolutely nail it!
review.jp:
第1話: 闇より浮かびて

『いやいや驚いた。実はコレが一番面白いかも・・・。しかも声優陣も新し目の人たちだし凄くフレッシュ感あふれていた。巷のチープな復讐・悪役令嬢などなどではなくもともとがよくわからないけど記憶もろくになく凄く強かった存在が一日だけのために病で死にそうな女子に転生されるところからの流れもいいし、ちょうどいい感じで強さをアピールしたがるのもいい。テンポも見せ方もいちいちハマっている。いやいや期待しかない。OPEDもバッチリ!』

entries.romanized_title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei Naru Musouroku
entries.synopsis:
Lying on her deathbed with seemingly no chance at recovery, a young Nia Liston is soon to succumb to her illness. Unable to give up hope, her parents desperately search for a cure in even the most obscure places, leading to the appearance of a hooded man claiming he can help rid Nia of her condition. But rather than curing her, the hooded man transplants the soul of a deceased hero who was undefeated in battle into the girl's frail body.

Given a second chance at life as Nia, the hero is determined to recover her new body's strength by using a technique known as chi to target and eliminate the illness at its roots. With her enthusiastic hunger for combat having also been carried over, Nia is eager to return to exploring the world. However, the hero's restless soul yearns to find a worthy opponent who can defeat her on the battlefield, sparking chaos wherever Nia may go.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

entries.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
entries.jpTitle: 生徒会にも穴はある！

review.en:
Episode #2

"An absolutely relentless rampage—can you feel the sheer determination behind it? Is this Passione's revenge for Nuki◯ashi?"

Whoa, this is getting seriously wild... You can practically feel the burning passion—and maybe even a bit of obsession—coming from Passione. Is this their way of getting revenge for *Nukitashi*? It certainly feels that way. They're constantly pushing the boundaries everywhere you look—or rather, outright crossing them. And as a school comedy, they're clearly determined to cram in just about everything they can, already throwing in a test-of-courage event in only the second episode. What's even funnier is that, instead of focusing on the ecchi stuff, the whole thing turns into a ridiculous competition over who's scared and who gets to play the dependable protector. And somehow, even when the MC ends up clinging to the student council president, nobody bats an eye! The hopeless pink-haired secretary introduced this episode is another great addition, too. That line about how "insertion on school grounds is a bit..." genuinely cracked me up. Man, I'm loving this... But can they really keep this up? Can they?! Honestly, it looks like they just might.
review.jp:
第2話: 「メシアたん」「七不思議と夜のお仕事」「こまろ現る!!」

"怒涛の快進撃、執念すら感じるのはあのぬ◯たしのリベンジか?"

『いや、ヤバいな・・・。パッショーネの情念を感じる。「ぬきたし」のリベンジ?とも思えるような・・・。もうそこかしこにギリギリの挑戦、いや線を超えてしまっている挑戦をしている。学園モノとしてもやれることはどんどんやるということで2話目で肝試し的なものもやるし、そこではエロさよりも怖がる、頼られたい争いばかりに集中してるのも逆に面白い。結局MCが会長に抱きついてても誰も突っ込まない。また今回登場したダメダメな庶務のピンク髪もなかなかにいい。学園内で挿入はちょっと・・・には笑わせて頂きました。いいですねぇ・・・、これは続くかぁ?続くのかぁ?ってところです。行けそうだけどね。』

entries.synopsis:
Ume Mizunoe, a first-year student at the prestigious Fujinari Academy, excels in Japanese literature but struggles so badly in science that his chances of advancing are at risk. Hoping to boost his academic record, he joins the student council—only to find himself surrounded by a cast of quirky characters: a charismatic yet secretly shy president, a kind but intimidating treasurer, an adorably cheeky boy, and a tiny, stray-cat-like secretary.

Thrown into a whirlwind of chaotic daily life, Ume's school days are about to get a lot more unpredictable—and a lot more lively!

(Source: MAL News)
entries.synopsis_ja:

高等部１年の水之江梅は文学賞などを多数受賞したりと国語の成績は抜群な一方、理系科目は進級に響くほど壊滅的。
留年回避のため、内申点をあげるため生徒会の役員となることに。

しかし、彼が入った生徒会にはカリスマむっつり生徒会長・古都吹寿子、怖くて優しい清楚な会計・照井有栖。
生意気可愛い男の子・尾鳥たん、小っちゃな捨て猫庶務・陸奥こまろと何やら変わった子たちが勢揃い！

entries.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
entries.jpTitle: マロニエ王国の七人の騎士

review.en:
Episode #2: Spring By The Lake

"A little quirky, but not in a way that really bothers me—or so I hope. There's something strangely captivating about it."

I can't quite explain why, but this is incredibly entertaining. It might actually be my favorite show of the season... So the real culprit was a ridiculously fat squirrel, huh? The relationship between the princess and that perpetually cold guy is intriguing, too. And is the eldest son somehow involved in all this? Then there's Eleonora... Just what happened in the past? It's such a strange, mysterious story, and I absolutely love it.
review.jp:
第2話: 湖上の春

"癖はあるがそこまで気にならないタイプ?のハズ、不思議な魅力に期待が持てる"

『何故かよくわからないけど凄く面白い、今期一番面白いかも・・・。真犯人は肥え太ったリスか・・・。王女と寒がりやの関係も面白いし、長男もそれに多少関わるのか?とエレオノーラとか・・・。そして過去に何があったのか?不思議な話・・・。好みだわぁ。』

entries.synopsis:
At the center of a continent made up of eight kingdoms lies the Kingdom of Marronnier. Leading the nation is the female general Baribara, who has seven sons, each with a personality all his own.

Sleepy, benevolent, sensitive to heat, sensitive to cold, gifted with animals, proud of his swordsmanship, and always hungry—the brothers possess very different qualities, but they are united by a single goal: "Someday, we'll rescue a princess in a cool way!"

Before long, the brothers set out for the seven neighboring kingdoms as ambassadors. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unfamiliar lands?

Set in a medieval-inspired fantasy world, this tale of romance and adventure begins.

(Source: MAL News)

「眠くない」「博愛」「暑がりや」「寒がりや」「獣使い」「剣自慢」「ハラペコ」－それぞれ異なる資質を持つ彼らの大義は、ただひとつ。
「いつか、かっこよくお姫様を助けること!!」
やがて兄弟たちは、七つの国へ“大使”として旅立つ。未知の土地で彼らを待ち受ける出会いと試練、そして宿命とは－。中世風の異世界を舞台に描かれる、恋と冒険のファンタジーロマンス、ここに開幕！

entries.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
entries.jpTitle: 『薬屋のひとりごと』第3期

review.en:
Episode #2: Fire Rat's Cloak

"Even an understated episode is on a completely different level—such depth that slowly but surely sinks in."

What a great episode. This series (along with *The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity*) is simply in a league of its own compared to everything else. There's nothing particularly flashy about this episode either, yet it remains fascinating from beginning to end. How could I possibly get bored of this? The first half, with the story of the fire-rat robe and the mystery surrounding it, was thoroughly engaging, while the second half brought us a long-awaited dose of Jinshi and Maomao together again. Their interactions felt so wonderfully familiar, yet there was also a sense of just how deep their bond has become. The way Jinshi wanted her to sing him a lullaby and then almost immediately drifted off to sleep, completely at ease... There's really no doubt that she's the woman he truly loves. I've lost count of how many times I've said this, but seriously, what a fantastic episode.
review.jp:
第50話: 火鼠の皮衣

"派手さのないい回ですら桁違いの面白さ、じわじわと来る深さよ"

『面白い。この作品（と「氷の城壁」）だけが他の作品とレベルが段違い。今回も派手さはないがずーっと見ていて面白い。飽きるはずがない。前半の火鼠の皮衣の話しと謎解きも面白かったし、後半の久々の人士とマオマオの絡みもなんとも慣れ親しんだ中に深結びつきを感じるいいものでよかった。子守唄を唄ってほしくてそれですぐに安心して寝てしま威厳気になるのは本当に想っている女性（ひと）で間違いないでしょうね。何回言ったかわからないが、面白かった。』

entries.synopsis:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan's rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation." To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again. From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

一方、本来の身分・皇弟であることを明かし、その責務に向き合い始めた壬氏は、楼蘭から最後に託された≪国を襲う災害の予兆≫に頭を悩ませていた。さらにそこへ、人々を惑わす謎の仙女の噂も飛び交いはじめ、茘国にはふたたび影が落ち始めていた。
物語の舞台は後宮から市井、さらに隣国へと広がり、猫猫と壬氏には新たなる試練が待ち受ける。

entries.title: Hotel Inhumans Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『ホテル・インヒューマンズ』第2期

review.en:
Episode #1: Piano Lesson 1

There's something distinctly cinematic about this episode, almost like a film or a live-action drama. Rather than spelling things out, it lets the interactions and relationship between the two characters unfold through their piano lessons. There's clearly something quiet yet deeply complex going on beneath the surface, but I guess we'll have to wait until Part 2 to find out what it is. It was genuinely intriguing and captivating in its own understated way, and I'm definitely curious to see what comes next. Looks like this season is off to a good start, too... Actually, I might have even higher expectations now. Oh, and I guess Sara hasn't shown up yet, huh?
review.jp:
第1話: ピアノ・レッスン1

『ちょっと独特な映画やドラマのような作り。具体的なものを多くは語らない代わりに2人のやり取りや関係性をピアノレッスンを通して見せる。そこには静かながら深く、複雑なものが絡んでいるに違いないが、それはパート2でのお楽しみ。なかなか興味深く、引き寄せられる意味で面白かった。続きが気になる。今期もいい感じ…というか更に期待が持てるかも。あ、沙羅はまだ出てこないのね。』

entries.title: Romelia War Chronicle
entries.jpTitle: ロメリア戦記

review.en:
Episode #2: Start of the Fortress Capture

I think this is pretty good overall. The MC has a distinct presence, almost like a cross between Saber and Violet Evergarden, and the production quality is consistently high. But there's something that bothers me: it feels as though everything has been conveniently placed exactly where the plot needs it to be. We start with the protagonist already engaged to a prince and the story picking up just before the Demon Lord's defeat. Sure, I can tell she's supposed to be exceptionally capable, but how did she become powerful enough to be part of a frontline party taking on the Demon Lord—presumably one of the most formidable beings in this world? And why was she even there in the first place? We have practically no idea.

Then there's the place they arrive at in this episode. The local lord is simply established as a complete asshole, and among the soldiers, there's apparently some guy who already hates the MC for whatever reason—and naturally, he's one of their leaders. Meanwhile, the MC keeps demonstrating just how competent she is at every opportunity. It almost feels like nearly everything that should be sparking my curiosity or drawing me into the story has instead been reduced to a pre-established condition or a convenient piece of backstory, without actually showing us the things that would make those elements compelling in the first place.

Right after watching the episode, I thought, "Hey, this is pretty good!" But after letting it sink in for a while, I started having second thoughts. Wait a minute... Something feels off here. Am I just being dazzled by the production quality? Still, there's no denying that it's a well-crafted show with genuine appeal, so I'm sticking with this rating for now. Let's see where it goes from here.
review.jp:
第2話: 砦攻略開始

なかなかいいと思う。MCもちょっとセイバーとヴァイオレット（エヴァーガーデン）を足して2で割ったようでたってるし、全体的なクオリティも高いし。ただ全てがプロットのためにそこにおいてあるかのように感じる。主人公と王子の婚約状態と、魔王討伐直前からのスタート。MCが優秀らしいのは分かるが、何故"魔王"という恐らく最強?レベルのものを討伐する最前線のパーティにまでいられる実力があるのか、どんな理由でそこにいたのか?もまるでわからない。今回来た場所でも、領主が前提としてクソ、そして兵隊の中に前提としてMCを憎んでる?やつがいてそいつがリーダー格。MCはそこかしこで優秀さを見せる・・・・。基本、意欲を掻き立てるものはほぼ全て、見せておくべきものを見せてないで、前提条件、設定にしてしまっているだけ?という気もしてしまう。視聴直後はいいねぇと思ったけど、少し時間が立つと、いや・・・待てよ・・・なんかなぁ・・・クオリティに騙されてないか?と思い始めてしまう。ただ、それでもしっかりと作られているし、魅力もあるのは確かなので今のところはこの評価。今後に期待。

entries.synopsis:
Rising from the ashes, a fallen noblewoman stands to save humanity!

After the Demon King's defeat, Countess Romelia's world is shattered when Prince Henri, her fiancé, publicly breaks off their engagement, dismissing her as "useless" alongside his new allies: Saint Elizabeth, the sage Ekaterina, and the swordswoman Lu Hime. What they don't realize is that Romelia possesses a secret power called "Grace," which brings her extraordinary luck. Left abandoned and humiliated, Romelia refuses to give up. With her homeland still under siege by the remnants of the demon army and her people enslaved, she embarks on a desperate mission to save them.

Facing overwhelming challenges—no army, no healers, no funds, and only inexperienced recruits—Romelia uses her wit and determination to turn the odds in her favor. She seizes fortresses from local lords to build her forces, negotiates with the church for healing, secures funds from merchants, and has her soldiers gain experience through monster hunting. Against all expectations, Romelia rises from the ashes, leading her loyal followers in a daring campaign to rescue her people and prove her worth.

(Source: MAL News)
entries.synopsis_ja:
長きにわたり旅をし、魔王ゼルギスを討ち果たしたロメリアと婚約者のアンリ王子。
しかし、アンリ王子は無慈悲にもロメリアに告げる。「婚約を破棄する」と。
勝利に酔いしれるアンリたちを横目に、ロメリアは次なる旅へと向かった。
戦乱を通じて荒廃した祖国と、魔族に奪われた人々の暮らし。
魔王を倒したからといって、目の前に積みあがった問題が片付くわけではない。
だから、私は私のやり方で、人々の幸せな暮らしを取り戻してみせる。
軍を興し、経済を動かし、時に陰謀に巻き込まれながらも、彼女は歩みを止めない。
しかしその選択は、ロメリアの前にさらなる戦禍を運んでくる。
これは、魔王討伐の『その後』を描く、「一人の少女」と「彼女を支える騎士たち」の、再起の物語。

entries.title: #I'm Looking For a Zombie
entries.jpTitle: #ゾンビさがしてます

review.en:
Episode #2: I'm Looking For My Friends.

Could this be the episode that turns things around? I'm definitely being pretty generous with my judgment here, but I really liked the story of Mikazuki, who suddenly showed up out of nowhere this episode. And through her involvement, I feel like I finally gained a little perspective on why the characters have been so ridiculously laid-back—something that had honestly been getting on my nerves, both in the first episode and up until now. Ah, so they've only just gotten out of the facility. That actually explains a few things.

Mikazuki herself was also quite compelling, especially her bittersweet interactions with the MC. And the fact that they ultimately had to put her down after she returned made for an effective contrast with the disposal of the stray zombie by the river earlier in the episode. That parallel was particularly well done. Against my expectations, I'm starting to get the feeling that this might actually turn into something pretty interesting after all. So, an 8 it is.
review.jp:
第2話: 仲間さがしてます

『起死回生の１打か?相当に緩い判定なのは間違いないが、今回唐突にやってきたミカヅキの話がよかった。そして彼女との関わりによって、1話でも今までもゆるゆる過ぎるキャラたちに苛立ちすら感じていたものが少し納得いった気がする。施設を出たばかりだからなんだと。またそのミカヅキのあり方やMCとの切ないやり取り、最終的に戻ってきたミカヅキを始末しなければいけなかったことと、前半の河原でののらゾンビの始末との対比もよかった。意外と面白くなりそうな予感を感じたので8点。』

entries.synopsis:
Set in a world where 90% of humanity has contracted and died from a deadly, virulent disease, only to rise again as attacking zombies, thirteen years have passed since the "Red Day" of societal collapse. The surviving humans now live away from the big cities, still hoping to reclaim them one day. An entirely new generation, unaware of the pre-Red Day world, is coming into its own.

The story begins when Aki, who has no memories of the world before its fall, escapes her village with her close friends Haru and Natsuki to search for her missing father. As they venture into the outside world, they find themselves surrounded by zombies on all sides! Along the way, they rescue Yuu and Sakura and take refuge in a home improvement store. They regroup, and now the counterattack begins—!!

(Source: Kadokawa, edited)
entries.synopsis_ja:
「これは人違い……いや、ゾンビ違い」

壊滅前の記憶がない新世代のアキは、かつて村を出て行った父親を探すため、幼馴染のナツキ、ハルと共に村を抜け出す。
村から出ると、どこもかしこもゾンビだらけ。それでも初めて感じる“外の世界”は、広大で、新鮮で、美しい！
道中出会ったユウ、サクラも加わって、少年少女の過酷で楽しい新生活がはじまる——

『三ツ星カラーズ』『ひとりぼっちの〇〇生活』のカツヲが描く、ゾンビだらけの“非”日常系エンターテインメント！

entries.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『氷の城壁』第2期

review.en:
Episode #2: Stop and Go

Yeah, it's interesting, and as always, the show does an impressively delicate job of picking up on and portraying the tiniest emotional nuances. But... I'm starting to feel like I've had enough of all these unnecessarily complicated feelings and misunderstandings. I mean, why did Amamiya even tell Yota that she liked Koyun as a friend in the first place? It feels like everything comes down to whether that one conversation happened or not... or something along those lines. Still, it's good. I do like it. Hence the 8. Oh, and speaking of which, isn't that younger girl kind of... unappealing? Or rather, doesn't she just lack any distinguishing features? She barely has any presence at all.
review.jp:
第2話: 停止と進行

『いや、面白いし、いつも通りよくもまぁ繊細に摘み取って描いているけど・・・。こじらせ?がもういいかな・・・とも思うというか、そもそも何でアマミヤはコユンのことを友達として好きとヨウタに言ったのだろう。もう、あれがあったかないかだけ・・・というか・・・。いや、でもいいんだけどね。だから8点。っていうかあの後輩の女は可愛くないというか、特徴なさすぎないか?存在感ないし。』

entries.synopsis: Second season of Koori no Jouheki.
entries.synopsis_ja:
人と接するのが苦手で、他人との間に壁を作ってしまう高校生・氷川小雪。幼なじみの安曇美姫以外誰ともつるまず、静かに日々を過ごしていた彼女の前に、なぜかぐいぐい距離を詰めてくる男子・雨宮湊が現れて――？親交を深めていく内に、お互いに友達以上の感情を抱くようになった小雪と湊。
長年抱えていた想いを美姫に伝えた陽太。想いを伝える者、心の内に秘める者、それぞれの矢印はすれ違いを加速していく。孤高の女子・小雪、元学校のアイドル・美姫、距離ナシ男子・湊、優しく穏やかなバスケ部員・陽太。不器用で、じれったくて、それでも愛おしい。青春のすれ違いが織りなす群像劇は進んでいく。

entries.title: Magic Knight Rayearth (2026)
entries.jpTitle: 魔法騎士レイアース

review.en:
Episode #1: The Birth of the Legendary Magic Knights!

That was pretty good! You can tell they put a lot of effort into it, and it strikes a nice balance between old-school charm and something fresh. The nostalgic character designs and overall atmosphere feel like they've been given a real upgrade in quality, which I really appreciate. What's especially impressive is how the whole thing manages to be completely over-the-top without ever making me go, "Oh, come on..." There's this strange, hard-to-explain sense of conviction that somehow makes it all work. I simply had a great time watching it. It was genuinely entertaining. Though, to be fair, I still have absolutely no idea what the hell is going on...
review.jp:
第1話: 伝説の魔法騎士（マジックナイト）始動

『なかなか良かった。かなり気合はいってたし、ふるさと新しさをいい感じのバランスで見せていた。哀愁のデザインと雰囲気がクオリティアップしている感じでいいと思えた。ぶっ飛んでいるのにおいおい・・・とはならないよくわからない説得力が素晴らしい。単純に楽しめたし面白い。まぁそれでもナンノコッチャなんですけど・・・。』

entries.synopsis:
Three high school girls—hot-blooded Hikaru Shidou, haughty Umi Ryuuzaki, and gentle Fuu Hououji—have just met at Tokyo Tower when they hear a call for help that pulls them into another world. They are soon greeted by Guru Clef, a youthful-looking man who informs them that they are the legendary Magic Knights summoned by Princess Emeraude to save this magical land known as Cephiro.

While Hikaru finds the prospect exciting, Umi and Fuu simply want to return to their own world. Unfortunately for them, Clef explains that they cannot go home until they have saved Cephiro and banished the monsters plaguing it. In order to do so, they have to rescue Princess Emeraude from the clutches of the powerful Lord Zagato. To stand a chance against him, they must revive mysterious beings called Rune Gods.

As Clef grants the trio armor and magic, one of Zagato's servants attacks, forcing the guru to send the girls away to the weaponsmith Presea and the rabbit-like guide Mokona, who can further equip them for their journey. Though they have a long way to go, Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu will show that they have what it takes to live up to their titles as Magic Knights and bring salvation to Cephiro.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

entries.title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
entries.jpTitle: 超巡！超条先輩

review.en:
Episode #1: The Psychic Senior Police Officer

This one was completely off my radar, but it's actually not that bad... or rather, it feels like a mishmash of all sorts of familiar elements. Cops, superpowers, a partnership with a female police officer who's got her own baggage, and a protagonist who acts like a complete goofball but is actually a good guy—or maybe he's just a goofball who also happens to be a good guy? Something like that? In a way, it's about as formulaic as it gets. I might keep watching if I feel like it, but I'll probably drop it from my ranking lineup.
review.jp:
第1話: 超能力巡査長

『完全にノーマークだったがそこまで悪くないというか・・・なんかいろんなのが混ざったような作品。警察、超能力、しがらみのある女性景観とのパートナーシップ、ふざけてるけど実は良いやつ層でやっぱりふざけてそうでいいやつ?的な?ある意味コテコテ。気が向いたら視聴は続けるかも?対象からは外しそう。』

entries.title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 探偵はもう、死んでいる。Season2

review.en:
Episode #1: To See You Once More

This was painfully boring. Who's who again? I don't remember a damn thing. What exactly do the people behind this show think viewers are looking for? And what are we even supposed to be curious about? I couldn't care less about any of these characters, what happened to them, or what we're supposedly going to find out next. Tague... please, just put this thing out of its misery. The original was already terrible, and now you're bringing it back after what, five years? If you're going to make a sequel, at least do it while people still remember the damn story! Otherwise, nobody's going to watch it. Honestly, it was so awful that it almost made me wish we lived in a world where the response to that would simply be, "Well, then let's not make the anime—or the sequel—at all!"
review.jp:
第1話: もう一度、君に会うために

『非常につまらない。誰が誰?何も覚えてもいない。制作は、視聴者がこの作品に何を求めていると思っているのだろう?そして、人は何を知りたくて見るのだろう?どのキャラにも、何があったのかも、何がこのあと分かるのか?のにも興味も持てない。たぐえんよ・・・切ってくれ。もともと酷い作品だったのに…5年?も空けてさ、続きやるなら、せめて覚えてるうちにやれよ。そうじゃなきゃ誰も見ない…、じゃあアニメ化、続編制作もやめよう!という世の中だったらいいのに…とすら思うほど酷かったという話。』

entries.synopsis_ja:
「君、私の助手になってよ」
巻き込まれ体質の少年・君塚君彦は、上空一万メートルを飛ぶ飛行機の中、《世界の敵》と戦う《名探偵》の少女・シエスタの助手となった。それから二人は、三年にもわたって世界中を飛び回り、目も眩むような冒険劇を繰り広げ、そして激闘の果てに――死に別れた。
シエスタの死から一年。一人生き残ってしまった君塚の元に、依頼人を名乗る少女・夏凪渚が現れる。彼女の依頼を受けて再び助手となった君塚は、やがて《名探偵》の死の真相に辿り着いた――。
しかし、その真相に触れて、君塚たちは知っていく。完全無欠の名探偵が犯したミスを。《名探偵》の遺志を継ぐことの真の意味を。
探偵はもう、死んでいる。死の真相も明かされた。
でも、エピローグにはまだ早い。

entries.title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
entries.jpTitle: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い

review.en:
Episode #1: The Cold Sato-San

Wait, what? That was her first love?! Oh, come on... The MC is the son of a guy who runs this ridiculously stylish café, and his dad is an absolute mountain of muscle. Then there's the whole thing with him giving her konpeito candy while sitting next to her during the entrance exam. There's no way she'd forget something like that! And that photo is so absurdly blurry... It's all just so stupid. And of course, there's Miku Ito, too... This is terrible. Absolutely terrible. Looks like this one's going straight into my "please entertain me with how awful you are" category. Oh, and has Tezuka Productions actually stepped up its animation quality a bit?
review.jp:
第1話: 塩対応の佐藤さん

『えっ?初恋だったの?もうさ・・・MC凄いおしゃれなカフェの息子で、父親超マッチョなデカい筋肉の塊だし・・・入学試験隣で金平糖あげてるし、そんなの忘れるわけないし、写真がぶれすぎだし・・・あほくさいし・・・伊藤美来だし・・・。酷い。酷さで楽しませてください枠ですね。手塚アニメーションはちょっと作画レベル上がったの?』

entries.romanized_title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
entries.synopsis:
Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length.

However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media.

Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing.

(Source: MAL News)
entries.synopsis_ja:
クラス中の高嶺の花、佐藤こはる。
誰にも笑顔を見せない、通称“塩対応の佐藤さん”。

でもある日、同じクラスの押尾颯太が、実家が営むカフェで見た佐藤さんの姿は……
スイーツの写真を撮るため奮闘する、隙だらけの姿で!?

本当は人見知りで不器用なだけの佐藤さんと、そんな佐藤さんのことが好きな押尾君。
二人の距離は、スイーツとカメラをきっかけに、少しずつ縮まっていく。

もどかしくて、愛おしい。
世界で一番甘い両片想いに、きっとあなたもとろけてしまう――。

不器用な二人が織りなす“甘くてしょっぱい”青春ラブコメディ！
